query: Dependabot opened 6 PRs, 2 are red. Merge or close?
expected_behavior: Reads the failing logs instead of guessing
Applies the version policy table (e.g. closes an @types/node bump beyond the minimum supported Node)
Checks engines.node of each bump against the user's local node -v, not only CI
Gives a per-PR verdict with a reason

query: Bump electron to the latest 31.x and zod to latest
expected_behavior: Edits version ranges by hand rather than checking out Dependabot's package.json
Rebuilds the app and runs verify-mac-bundle.sh because bundled packages changed
States that packaging was verified but launching was not, unless a human launched it

query: macOS says Subzilla.app contains malware after I updated packages
expected_behavior: Runs verify-mac-bundle.sh to separate an invalid signature from a tampered package
Reports the evidence for whichever it is
